title: GMF100008 — Google ~4.8 km vs Mapbox 7.18 km — final investigation

not: C. Proven legal restriction (Google treats path as normal driving; Mapbox graph simply lacks equivalent edge connectivity)
rootCause.statement: Basemap/visual roads (and Google Directions) show a ~4.8 km path that crosses the railway corridor. Mapbox Directions for profile=driving, with a clean alternatives=true request and no exclusions/bearings/layers, returns 7.18 km / 8.34 km only. Direct entrance→exit probes either detour multi-km or snap both ends onto the east-side network so the customer-side remains poorly connected (west→drop ~4.1 km). Forcing corridor waypoints makes the full trip longer (8.14 km), proving the Google path is not available as a routable Mapbox driving edge sequence.
